$comment: Every Discord role the room can create, reuse or award. key is permanent (it is what players' awards are stored under); name and emoji can be renamed freely and the sync script renames the Discord role to match. Rarity sets the colour of earned roles so the colour means something across families. A stat unlock with value null is switched off until an admin sets a threshold from real play data. Nothing here is awarded by guessing: generation roles are self-selected, manual roles are handed out by staff, and chat levels come from Tatsu.

roles.name: The New Kid
roles.meaning: First day at a new school. Everyone was one once.

roles.name: Cafeteria Regular
roles.meaning: You found a lunch table and people save you a seat.

roles.name: One of the Homies
roles.meaning: The crew waits for you at the bike rack.

roles.name: Note Passer
roles.meaning: Folded into a perfect triangle. Never got caught.

roles.name: Class Clown
roles.meaning: You bring the laughs. The sub never stood a chance.

roles.name: Permanent Hall Pass
roles.meaning: You go where you want. Teachers just nod.

roles.name: Big Kid on Campus
roles.meaning: Everybody knows your name. Even the lunch lady.

roles.name: Class President
roles.meaning: You promised pizza Fridays. You delivered.

roles.name: School Legend
roles.meaning: They still tell stories about you in the hallway.

roles.name: Childhood Icon
roles.meaning: The top of the yearbook. There is nothing higher.

roles.name: Baby Boomer
roles.meaning: Transistor radios, drive-ins, and Saturday matinees.

roles.name: Gen X
roles.meaning: Latchkeys, Atari, and the first MTV.

roles.name: Millennial
roles.meaning: Game Boys, dial-up, and taping songs off the radio.

roles.name: Gen Z
roles.meaning: DS styluses, Club Penguin, and the first smartphones.

roles.name: Gen Alpha
roles.meaning: Tablets before training wheels.

roles.name: Gen Beta
roles.meaning: Born into the future. Visiting the past.

roles.name: Long Bar Believer
roles.meaning: Clear 40 lines in one game of Tetris on the room's PC. You waited for the I-piece and it came.

roles.name: Tetris Champion
roles.meaning: Score 100,000 in one game of PC Tetris. The music sped up and so did you.

roles.name: Professional Minesweeper (Unpaid)
roles.meaning: Win Minesweeper on Expert. Your parents thought you were doing homework.

roles.name: Bouncing Cards Witness
roles.meaning: Win a game of Solitaire and watch the cards cascade. Best screensaver ever made.

roles.name: Orange Track Rookie
roles.meaning: Finish a full Hot Wheels race under the bed and over the desk.

roles.name: Track Speed Demon
roles.meaning: Finish a Hot Wheels race faster than the set time. Threshold is set from real race times once there are enough.

roles.name: Toy Chopper Ace
roles.meaning: Fly the toy helicopter through all ten rings, from out of town to home on the pad.

roles.name: Plastic Army General
roles.meaning: Hold the toy town through all three tan army waves.

roles.name: The Dog Stopped Laughing
roles.meaning: Down every duck in a round on the shelf range. Not a single snicker.

roles.name: Never Peeled a Sticker
roles.meaning: Solve the Rubik's Cube for real. No peeling, no taking it apart with a butter knife.

roles.name: Cube Wizard
roles.meaning: Solve the Rubik's Cube in under two minutes.

roles.name: Good Boy Certified
roles.meaning: Help Poo-Chi find every one of his bones.

roles.name: I Spy a Champion
roles.meaning: Find everything on an I Spy page. Even the tiny marble.

roles.name: Free Parking Millionaire
roles.meaning: Win a full game of Monopoly. Nobody flipped the board.

roles.name: Kitchen Table Grandmaster
roles.meaning: Win a game of Wizard Chess.

roles.name: King Me Kid
roles.meaning: Win a game of Checkers.

roles.name: You Sunk My Battleship!
roles.meaning: Win a game of Battleship.

roles.name: Pretty Sneaky, Sis
roles.meaning: Win Connect Four. Diagonal, probably.

roles.name: It Was Mustard All Along
roles.meaning: Solve the murder in Clue before anyone else.

roles.name: Sorry, Not Sorry
roles.meaning: Win a game of Sorry! and apologise to nobody.

roles.name: YAHTZEE!
roles.meaning: Roll five of a kind and yell it.

roles.name: Basement Card Shark
roles.meaning: Win five hands of Blackjack against the ghost dealer.

roles.name: Go Fish Grandmaster
roles.meaning: Win a game of Go Fish.

roles.name: Does Your Person Wear a Hat?
roles.meaning: Win a game of Guess Who.

roles.name: Mouse Trap Master
roles.meaning: Build the whole contraption and catch the mouse. It actually worked.

roles.name: Poker Face
roles.meaning: Win a game of Texas Hold'em.

roles.name: Total Know-It-All
roles.meaning: Win a match of Throwback Trivia.

roles.name: Floppy Disk Kid
roles.meaning: Open three different programs on the room's Windows PC.

roles.name: Cartridge Blower
roles.meaning: Fire up the NES. Blowing on the cartridge is optional but traditional.

roles.name: Game Boy Kid
roles.meaning: Sit on the bean bag and play the Game Boy until the batteries die.

roles.name: Windows 98 Survivor
roles.meaning: Beat Minesweeper on Expert and win Solitaire. The family PC is yours now.

roles.name: Family Game Night MVP
roles.meaning: Win five different board games. Somebody had to keep score.

roles.name: Bedroom Floor Veteran
roles.meaning: Ace the chopper course, hold the town, and clear the duck range. Mom still made you clean it up.

roles.name: Keeper of Childhood
roles.meaning: Earn ten game or nostalgia roles.

roles.name: Walking Time Capsule
roles.meaning: Earn twenty-five game or nostalgia roles. You are basically a museum.

roles.name: YOU HAD TO BE THERE
roles.meaning: One of the first 50 people to sign in with Discord. Before it was cool.

roles.name: Family Computer Technician
roles.meaning: Found and reported a real bug. Have you tried turning it off and on again?

roles.name: Playground Trade King
roles.meaning: Made the server a better place. Awarded by the staff.

roles.name: Saturday Morning Royalty
roles.meaning: Hosted or ran a community event. Cartoons and cereal on you.

roles.name: Game Tester
roles.meaning: Helps test new rooms and games before anyone else.
